name: Bittersweet Romance
source:
A kami dating sim, where you play a boy trying to get a date for the school dance. Six different endings.

Warning! contains mature themes!

[From [url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/pages/bittersweetromance.html]Otaku World[/url]]
translation:
一款纸芝居恋爱模拟游戏，你将扮演一个想为学校舞会找舞伴的男孩。有六种不同的结局。

请注意！内含成人向主题！

［取自[url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/pages/bittersweetromance.html]Otaku World[/url]］
